Name: Better TV Dialogue
Author: tnt2018
Description:
Better TV Dialogue is my first ever mod, which changes the dialogue given on the TV. It changes the interaction menu, what the Weatherman says, and slight changes to the Fortune Teller.
This mod requires: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/url]﻿
And you also need: [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) by Pathoschild[/url]﻿

How to Install:
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿

[*]Download Better TV Dialogue

[*]Extract ZIP Files into your Mods Folder

[*]Download Content Patcher ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/url]﻿)
[*]Extract ZIP Files into your Mods Folder
[*]Run Stardew Valley using SMAPI.
[/list]
If downloaded correctly, you should find when you interact with your TV, the selection menu should be different.
